rows.name: Polars/pandas/DuckDB/Spark
rows.fallback: Keep the current proved engine and run one representative query or pipeline before changing it.

rows.name: dataframe-to-array or solver boundary
rows.fallback: Keep the higher-level representation until dtype, layout, copy, memory and result tolerance are proved at the boundary.

rows.name: NumPy/Numba/native/GPU
rows.fallback: Retain the correctness-checked baseline until compile-inclusive and steady-state measurements justify one promotion.

rows.name: eager/lazy/streaming/out-of-core and reproducibility
rows.fallback: Use the simplest repeatable plan that fits; record spill, ordering, peak memory and output agreement before promotion.

rows.name: static/SSR/CSR/islands/PWA/native
rows.fallback: Keep meaningful content available without client execution and add runtime only for a measured interaction or offline need.

rows.name: novice versus expert density
rows.fallback: Choose density from representative novice and expert task evidence for this surface.

rows.name: semantic DOM/ARIA versus canvas/custom controls
rows.fallback: Keep a meaningful native control or content route until equivalent semantics and interaction behaviour are proved.

rows.name: house style and motion versus audience, accessibility and performance
rows.fallback: Audience, accessibility and measured target-device performance override optional house styling.

rows.name: modular monolith versus services
rows.fallback: Keep one deployable with enforced module seams until a measured ownership, release, isolation or capacity signal earns a split.

rows.name: synchronous versus queue/event/stream
rows.fallback: Keep the call synchronous unless waiting is unsafe; when asynchronous, make acknowledgement, retry, ordering and replay explicit.

rows.name: storage-engine selection
rows.fallback: Keep one proved store until a representative access trace and recovery path justify another engine.

rows.name: local/cloud/hybrid/offline and consistency
rows.fallback: Remain online-first and reject invariant-bearing offline writes until conflict and recovery behaviour are proved.

rows.name: spike versus hardened vertical slice
rows.fallback: Use the cheapest representative spike with a named deletion or hardening boundary.

rows.name: doubles/sandbox/live and oracle independence
rows.fallback: Use the highest-fidelity affordable boundary and prove a double against the real contract with an independent oracle.

rows.name: incident hotfix versus normal gates
rows.fallback: Use the normal path unless active user harm justifies a bounded route that retains non-waivable checks and rollback.

rows.name: build/buy/managed service versus portability and incident access
rows.fallback: Retain the smallest owned interface and proved export, diagnosis and recovery route.

rows.name: fail closed versus honest degradation
rows.fallback: Fail closed for protected properties and degrade only a truthful journey that preserves them.

rows.name: observability versus privacy
rows.fallback: Collect the minimum redacted signal that diagnoses the named journey and reject secret or cross-tenant telemetry.

rows.name: provenance/SBOM versus producer trust
rows.fallback: Verify producer and policy trust separately from provenance and inventory evidence.

rows.name: dependency freshness versus known-good deployment
rows.fallback: Keep known-good during routine pressure and use a proved staged security exception when delay is riskier.

rows.name: deterministic workflow/single agent/swarm
rows.fallback: Start with one bounded agent and an external oracle; add the smallest measured decomposition.

rows.name: local/hosted/hybrid models
rows.fallback: Keep protected data on the proved route and retain a deterministic or human outage fallback.

rows.name: deterministic/human/model judges
rows.fallback: Use deterministic external truth where possible; calibrate any human or model judge before it gates work.

rows.name: golden path versus autonomy
rows.fallback: Use existing stack profiles, seed routes and domain Wargames with their tested local escape decisions.

rows.name: local exception versus doctrine promotion
rows.fallback: Keep the exception venture-local until two argued rulings overlap and an accepted Doctrine review changes estate scope.
